items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: My personal opinion, and also that of Martin Williams, is that at least Steady Roll is without Morton.

ctx.x: By Martin. Yeah, by Martin. That's what I said.
Well, how about that record that you identified, Frog Eye Moore, with General Morton? Remember the one that was an acetate or test pressing that John Steiner dug up?
